name: camera-preview
title: Camera Preview
description: Preview your webcam feed in a full-screen window to check how you look before a call
author: vaaaaanquish

commands.name: preview-camera
commands.title: Preview Camera
commands.subtitle: Camera Preview
commands.description: Open a smooth live preview of your webcam

commands.name: select-camera
commands.title: Select Default Camera
commands.subtitle: Camera Preview
commands.description: Choose which of your connected cameras the preview starts with

preferences.name: cameraType
preferences.title: Camera
preferences.description: Which camera to start with. Keep "Selected Camera" to use the one picked with the Select Default Camera command, which is the only way to choose between cameras of the same kind

preferences.name: windowSize
preferences.title: Window Size
preferences.description: Size of the preview window. Anything smaller than full screen floats above other windows and can be dragged around

preferences.name: saveDirectory
preferences.title: Save Location
preferences.description: Where snapshots and recordings are written. Defaults to your Downloads folder

preferences.name: mirror
preferences.title: Display
preferences.label: Mirror the image horizontally
preferences.description: Shows the feed mirrored, which looks natural for a selfie-style preview. Press M while the preview is open to flip it

preferences.name: fill
preferences.title: Sizing
preferences.label: Fill the screen (crops the edges)
preferences.description: When off, the whole frame is fitted on screen with black bars

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
